decisions.statement: An account page is found by its title rather than by its id.
The title of an account page is the account name the game gave.
An account page absent is made rather than refused.
An upsert answering with no id is refused.
The refusal names the account rather than the import that asked.
A caller may hand in the function that does the upsert.
Nothing here reads or writes anything else about an account.

definition: the page for the game account a watcher import writes under, made where absent
